scope.description: Boot three voters with RestoreCommittedLogs and CommitTrackingLogs, disable automatic snapshots and take exactly one snapshot while the configuration is still the bootstrap one, add two further voters so the committed configuration has five servers, commit more entries, then restart the node that was leading from its own stores and compare the configuration it holds with the log's latest configuration. Run the same sequence with the flag on and off.
assumptions: The single deliberate snapshot carries only the bootstrap configuration, so it cannot represent the later membership change.
Automatic snapshots are disabled, so no newer snapshot can cover the change.
Adding the two voters commits because the leader still holds a majority of the committed configuration.
excluded: Any claim about an election won with the stale quorum; the partition stage of the harness is exploratory and produced no such leader.

basis.prefix: The harness uses the package's own test facilities: MakeClusterCustom with Peers 3, CommitTrackingLogs and RestoreCommittedLogs; ten Apply calls; an explicit Snapshot(); MakeClusterNoBootstrap(2) merged with FullyConnect and two AddVoter calls; ten further Apply calls; then Shutdown and NewRaft on the same logs, stable and snapshots stores with a fresh inmem transport, followed by FullyConnect on the rewired transports. It emits a startup_before_restart event carrying the snapshot index, the snapshot's configuration index, the expected configuration index and server count, then a multivoter_after_restart event with the configuration observed after NewRaft returns and the operand of the comparison.
basis.responsibility: The library owns the membership view a node resumes with; enabling RestoreCommittedLogs must not let an obsolete snapshot configuration govern the node's quorum arithmetic.

comparisons.description: After restarting from a log whose latest configuration has five servers while the snapshot carries three, the node's configuration index and server count are expected to match the log; the defect prediction is that it falls back to the snapshot's configuration.
Control: the identical restart without the flag is expected to keep the five-server configuration, isolating the recovery path rather than the restart and the membership change.
